text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During her first three years in the Twinkle Series,
Agnes Digital reigned supreme as the ultimate all-rounder.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There were no more paths left for her to conquer. Even so,
Agnes Digital continued to gaze up toward the training hill.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: The Master said, "My Way is bound together by a single continuous thread..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I have conquered
every single hill.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Once you reach the very top... where does the slope
lead next? After climbing all the way up, what's left is...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"That's the normal way to think. But here,
let's look at it through the eyes of a pervert."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
A dramatic low-angle shot...!
Looking at it from down here, this slope is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Bending down to look as instructed—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—The sky.
The path—led straight into the sky.”

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Did you notice? That's right, there's still
a path that I haven't conquered yet!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Which means—by air!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
It's finally time to set off.
Have a safe trip, Digital-san~.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Still, to think you'd go on an overseas expedition.
You didn't say a single word about having such grand ambitions.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's only natural I didn't say anything.
After all, it was just a spur-of-the-moment idea.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"I'm an all-rounder! Which means
I have to conquer every single racetrack!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And that includes racecourses across the globe!
You're only a true all-rounder if you can win in any country, yes indeed!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I see. Now that you mention it, you're right.
That's splendid, Digital-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At first glance, it's admirable. ...Yet I know.
There is a deeper reason behind it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"However, that is not the only reason I must fly out into the world.
I-I simply cannot contain... these humongous emotions...!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: What is it? What could it possibly be, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As her partner, I speak up loudly on her behalf.
And that is—
choice_data_list: I wanna meet every Uma Musume in the world!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Hyaaaaaa!?
To Umamusume... all over the world!?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I see. A preference swollen to its absolute maximum...
So you intend to satisfy that craving, then?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I just want to meet an Umamusume
who's stronger and cuter than me, that's all!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I want to chase, run alongside,
and connect with every single Umamusume out there!
There's no stopping this urge!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: So... I'm off!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I see. Then I shall wish you the best of luck.
However—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The world's kings are as strong as the Supreme Overlord herself.
—From Hong Kong's trading kings to Dubai's oil magnates.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: All-around genius though you may be, when they have home-field advantage, can you really win?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I-Indeed, they might know
their home turf inside and out...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Still, home-field advantage is always on my side!
And why is that? Because—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Because the Umamusume are there!!
As long as they're around, my energy is limitless!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Besides...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Besides?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ah, no, this is just a minor thing, hardly worth mentioning...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Besides... the preciousness I received from Opera O-san, Doto-san,
and all the other Umamusume...)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Because it's always there,
supporting me.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Trainer!
My one and only comrade!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna go see all the things I love across the whole world
with my beloved partner-in-crime!!!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Nothing could ever get me more pumped than this!
With this passion boiling over, the whole world is Makuhari to me!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Breathing heavily with excitement, Agnes Digital set off.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital in the lead! Agnes Digital pulls it off! A brilliant victory in Hong Kong!!
Her running has crossed the sea!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital puts up a valiant fight in Dubai as well!!
Charging straight through the burning sands!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Opera O-san, Digital-san is...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Yeah, she's really putting on an amazing show. All without even returning home, going on a grueling campaign across the globe...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: It seems there's no path she cannot walk.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Still... doesn't that get exhausting?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: How could she be tired? For she is—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Because you are the world traveler—the All-Rounder—
who loves encountering Umamusume more than anyone else."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are no borders to Agnes Digital's "love."
She keeps running as she pleases, wherever her heart takes her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Several Umamusume have achieved victory overseas.
However, only one true all-rounder has dominated the tracks so freely and completely.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh!!!!!!!!
Umamusume-chan is GOD!!!!!
